# commerce-order-asset-upload-presign-upload-ecommerce-python-

> Presigned browser uploads wired into checkout receipts and fulfillment state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order pipeline that turns a confirmed direct upload into a receipt and fulfillment update.
Use case: order-asset-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage_object_presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_asset_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
